title: AIWG Documentation
description: Reusable project context and specialist workflows for the AI tools you already use
tagline: Carry project context into your next task

welcome.headline: Give your AI assistant project context and specialist workflows
welcome.lead: AIWG helps you carry decisions forward and review complex work in the AI tools you already use. Start with one task, save an inspectable result, and use it as context for the next session.
pillars: Software development — Plan a change, review its implementation, and connect decisions to tests
Marketing and content — Prepare a campaign, review messaging, and apply a consistent writing style
Research and knowledge — Organize sources, trace citations, and keep a reference collection
Security and forensics — Structure reviews and investigations with recorded findings
Media curation — Assess a collection, organize metadata, and plan acquisition work
Operations — Prepare runbooks, review infrastructure, and document recovery steps
Optional utilities — Add workflow recovery, artifact indexing, and project-specific skills as needed

18 provider integrations — Google Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Factory AI, Grok Bot, Grok Build, Muse Code, Hermes, OpenCode, OpenClaw, OpenHuman, Oh My Pi, Pi Coding Agent, Warp Terminal, Devin Desktop
checklist: Open your project in your AI tool
Ask for a README review with three prioritized fixes
Inspect the saved report and choose the next change
welcome.quote: Make the next session start with what you learned today.
